rows.role_title: 代表 — representative of the 国民民主党 of May 2018 to September 2020 (旧・国民民主党; an earlier organization with the same name; claims only)
rows.text: It reports that in the representative election held at the extraordinary convention of the 4th, 玉木雄一郎 won 204 of 284 points and was elected new representative ('国民民主党が４日の臨時党大会で実施した代表選挙の投開票の結果、玉木雄一郎候補が新代表に選出された').
